thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager P1 — Canary rollout to eu-west-1 model-pool at 7% traffic reporting high 502/504 and tail latency >3s. Error rate 7.1% over 3m.
oncall_erica: I'm awake, taking pager. Pulling logs now. Any confirmed user impact?
support_raj: CS seeing ~6 tickets for streaming endpoints timing out. Small set of customers.
sre_jamie: If it's still 7% can we immediately halt the canary? We should cut traffic back to stable while we triage.
eng_miguel: Preliminary traces point to v4-quant KV cache eviction thrash for long contexts. Also seeing retry storms on the ingress side.
deploy_bot: Canary rollout id=cr-2026-71 status=running traffic=7% variant=v4-quant
infra_lee: I can prevent new canary workers from launching; traffic split controlled via feature flag key rollout.canary.routing (LD).
product_olivia: Confirmed key rollout.canary.routing in prod. Flip it to 0.
oncall_erica: Flipping: `launchdarkly-cli set rollout.canary.routing 0 --env prod`
oncall_erica: Done — traffic directed to stable v3.2.1. Visible in routing dashboard. :white_check_mark:
eng_miguel: Initiating manual eviction of v4-quant instances from model pool to avoid cache thrash returning: `redwoodctl pool evict --pool eu-west-1 --tag v4-quant`
deploy_bot: Eviction job ev-492001 started. Expected drain ~40s.
sre_jamie: Kicking off smoke harness: 20 synthetic streaming calls, 1M token stress test short. Watching router 5xx count.
support_raj: Notified affected customers with an ETA and brief explanation. Ticket owners updated.
infra_lee: Eviction completed exit=0. Removed 10 canary runners. Routing shows 100% to v3.2.1.
oncall_erica: Smoke tests: 20/20 200s, median latency 230ms, no 502s in last 3m.
eng_miguel: I see KV cache stabilization and no eviction spikes. Root cause likely cache under-alloc with quantized layers — profiler attached to follow up.
eng-ml: Will take RCA. Plan: repro with long-context sequences + quantized variant, add KV warmup and backpressure in runtime.
sre_jamie: Add a new alert to detect retry amplification and >5% 5xx in canary window. Also cap canary traffic to 5% until automated throttle.
product_olivia: PMs updated. We'll pause further v4 variants until patch + targeted QA.
support_raj: Customers informed that we've reverted the canary and are monitoring; no SLA credits issued.
incident-bot: Incident mitigated -> cause: model variant v4-quant causing KV cache evictions and retry amplification; mitigation: LD flag flip + manual eviction. Duration 00:12:29. Postmortem required.
oncall_erica: Handoff to eng-ml for full RCA. I'll stay pinned for 30m monitoring. Good job everyone. :clap:
